Glass has an etched floral/butterfly decorative pattern in the center.

No legs, frame, or base are present in the photo.
Edges of the glass show a hazy/whitish residue or discoloration, unclear if dirt, adhesive, or glass defect.
Background is a rough cement wall, suggesting outdoor/storage setting rather than a showroom.
